messages:
maya (AE): Heads-up — Acropolis asked for a Private POC with HSM-backed keys + mutual-TLS for internal service-to-service calls. They want to validate that key material never leaves HSM and also test short-lived client certs. Can Solutions/Security weigh in on handoff?

sanjeev (Solutions-Eng): Yep. We can do a Private deploy (VPC) and integrate with customer HSM (PKCS#11) or have them give a wrapped key via our KMS bridge. For the mutual-TLS flow we accept a CSR and install the signed cert on the node, or we can run an internal signing flow using Vault PKI if they want ephemeral certs.

maya (AE): They prefer customer-managed keys (BYOK) but want Redwood to sign client certs from their RA. Also asked for sample CSR commands and the audit evidence we can provide.

elena (Security): From an audit standpoint we need: 1) proof key never exported (HSM attestation or vendor statement), 2) key usage policy, 3) rotation plan (monthly/rolling), 4) audit logs showing sign/issue events with actor identities. We can provide templates for the attestation and a sample audit export.

owen (Infra): For network: we'll need a peered VPC and a small NAT gateway for outbound access to customer CA if they require OCSP/CRL checks. For the POC we can spin a Dedicated pool (2x A10G equivalent) for 3 weeks. Ops can lock the instance to the customer's subnet and mount the PKCS#11 endpoint over a private link.

maya (AE): Customer also asked about SSO + SAML access for their engineers to see logs. Is that on the table during POC?

sanjeev (Solutions-Eng): We can enable read-only SAML SSO to the Private Console. For the initial POC we'll create scoped API keys for app testing and a service account in their IdP for auditability.

maya (AE): Pricing question — they asked if the Dedicated POC has a discounted rate or trial credits.

owen (Infra): Sales can offer a POC discount — typical is 50% off infra for <4 weeks or apply X free hours of hosted API for pre-integration testing. Need finance signoff but we've done similar.

elena (Security): One blocker to watch: customer wants HSM to sign leaf certs but also requests we prove we never retain private keys. If they insist on RA-only signing, we need to accept signed certs and disable any server-side private key import. Confirm with them whether PKCS#11 remote signing is acceptable (sign ops happen in customer's HSM via API) or they will hand over only signed certs.

maya (AE): I'm pinging Acropolis legal to confirm RA model. @sanjeev can you paste a minimal CSR + openssl incantation I can give to their infra team?

sanjeev (Solutions-Eng): Sure — send this to them:

```
# generate a 2048-bit private key and CSR
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out acropolis-client.key -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048
openssl req -new -key acropolis-client.key -subj '/CN=acropolis-client/O=Acropolis Inc/OU=Platform' -out acropolis-client.csr

# CSR fields they should set for SANs if needed:
openssl req -in acropolis-client.csr -noout -text
```

sanjeev (Solutions-Eng): If they use PKCS#11 HSMs, they should generate keys there and produce a PKCS#11 CSR. We can accept the signed cert in PEM and install it on the node.

elena (Security): For evidence pack we can produce: HSM vendor attestation PDF, signing event logs (syslog + auditd exports), and a short control narrative describing RA workflow. I can draft the narrative.

maya (AE): Awesome. Customer also wants to test short-lived cert issuance (12h) during the POC. Any limits?

nowen (Infra): We can issue certs with TTL down to 1 hour using Vault PKI in the Private control plane. If they want the private CA to remain in their HSM, TTLs depend on their CA policy. We'll document both flows.

maya (AE): Next steps: 1) I will send the CSR snippet + SAML checklist to Acropolis. 2) @elena please draft the evidence pack template. 3) @owen can you provision a 2-node Dedicated POC pool for 3 weeks and prepare network peering checklist. I'll loop in finance for the discount.

owen (Infra): On it. I'll post the peering checklist and a terraform snippet in this thread once provisioned.

deploy-bot: deployment request received for POC pool (req-1991234). Status: queued.

maya (AE): Thanks team — I'll update the customer and share replies here. :thumbsup:
